text:
I'm sorry about your plant. Unfortunately, repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days isn't covered by the Plant Care Guarantee. Since you repotted on day 7 into other soil, a replacement likely isn't available, even though the plant died within the 30-day window.

If the soil was actually Leafy soil, you can submit a claim from "My Orders" with at least two photos (whole plant and close-up). A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days. If you'd like someone to look at your situation, I can escalate it. A Plant Care Specialist can also give you free care advice by chat or email for future plants.
